cards.ex: Her Olympic dreams were dashed when she broke her leg.
cards.exUz: Oyimpidagi orzulari oyog'ini sindirib olganida puchga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Umidlar amalga oshmay, yo'q bo'lib ketdi.

cards.ex: He had a fatalistic attitude and believed nothing he did mattered.
cards.exUz: U taqdirga tan berish kayfiyatida edi va qilgan hech narsasi ahamiyatga ega emas deb hisoblardi.
cards.uzDef: Narsalar o'zgarishi mumkin emas degan fikr bilan yashash.

cards.ex: In the midst of the crisis, her leadership became a beacon of hope.
cards.exUz: Inqiroz o'rtasida uning yetakchiligi umid mayoqiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda umid beruvchi odam yoki narsa.

cards.ex: As the rescue efforts slowed, despair set in among the survivors' families.
cards.exUz: Qutqaruv harakatlari sekinlashishi bilan omon qolganlarning oilalari orasida umidsizlik hukmron bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Umidsizlik hissi boshlanadi va kuchayadi.

cards.ex: The gray weather put her in a despondent mood.
cards.exUz: Kulrang ob-havo uni tushkun kayfiyatga soldi.
cards.uzDef: Tushkunlik va umidsizlik bilan to'lgan kayfiyat.

cards.ex: Even after the diagnosis, they clung to hope for a cure.
cards.exUz: Tashxisdan keyin ham ular davolanishga umid qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Umidni saqlab qolishga harakat qilish, hatto qiyin bo'lsa ham.

cards.ex: After failing the exam, he began to sink into despair.
cards.exUz: Imtihondan o'ta olmagach, u umidsizlikka bota boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Umidsizlik hissi tobora kuchayib, yengib bo'lmas holga keladi.

cards.ex: Losing the contract was a crushing blow to the company.
cards.exUz: Shartnomani yo'qotish kompaniya uchun og'ir zarba bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta umidsizlik yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlik.

cards.ex: Even though she lost her job, the silver lining was that she could spend more time with her family.
cards.exUz: U ishini yo'qotgan bo'lsa ham, yaxshi tomoni shundaki, u oilasi bilan ko'proq vaqt o'tkazishi mumkin edi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday yomon vaziyatda ham yaxshi bir narsa borligi.

cards.ex: Her resilient spirit helped her overcome many obstacles in life.
cards.exUz: Uning bardoshli ruhi hayotdagi ko'plab to'siqlarni yengishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, tezda tiklanish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Without support, the project will likely fade into oblivion.
cards.exUz: Qo'llab-quvvatlashsiz loyiha unut bo'lib ketishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Unutilish, yo'qolish.

cards.ex: Despite everything, I still harbor hope that things will get better.
cards.exUz: Hamma narsaga qaramay, men hali ham vaziyat yaxshilanishiga umid qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Umidingizni ichingizda saqlash, uni yashirincha asrash.

cards.ex: After the news, he plunged into gloom and refused to speak.
cards.exUz: Xabardan so'ng u tushkunlikka tushib qoldi va gapirishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga va chuqur tushkunlikka tushib qolish.

cards.ex: He tried to lighten the mood by telling a joke.
cards.exUz: U hazil aytib kayfiyatni ko'tarishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kayfiyatni yaxshiroq qilish, tushkunlikni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: She put on a brave face, even though she was terrified inside.
cards.exUz: U ichida qo'rqqan bo'lsa ham, jasur ko'rinishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rquv yoki umidsizlikni yashirib, jasur bo'lib ko'rinishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The company's been circling the drain for months; I doubt it will survive.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bir necha oydan beri oxiriga yetmoqda; menimcha u omon qolmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yomonlashib, halokatga yaqinlashmoq.

cards.ex: As the days passed with no news, optimism waned among the search party.
cards.exUz: Hech qanday yangiliksiz kunlar o'tishi bilan qidiruv guruhida optimizm so'na boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Optimistik qarashlar kamayib, so'nmoqda.

cards.ex: Many families are struggling to cope with the rising cost of living.
cards.exUz: Ko'p oilalar hayotning qimmatlashuviga bardosh berishga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatga bardosh berishga qiyinchilik bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Trying to convince him is a lost cause; he never listens.
cards.exUz: Uni ishontirish befoyda ish; u hech qachon eshitmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoni yo'q bo'lgan ish.

cards.ex: After the scandal, the company's stock price took a nosedive.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan keyin kompaniyaning aksiya narxi keskin pasayib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va keskin pasayish.

cards.ex: Despite the darkness, there's still a glimmer of light that things can improve.
cards.exUz: Qorong'ulikga qaramay, vaziyat yaxshilanishi mumkin degan umid uchquni bor.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, ammo umid beruvchi belgisi.

cards.ex: They were hoping against hope that their missing child would be found alive.
cards.exUz: Ular bedarak yo'qolgan farzandlari tirik topilishiga oxirgi umid bilan umid qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday imkoniyat yo'q bo'lsa ham, umid qilishda davom etish.

cards.ex: The company is trying to weather the storm of the economic recession.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya iqtisodiy tanazzul bo'ronidan o'tishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin davrni muvaffaqiyatli o'tkazish.

cards.ex: A sense of hopelessness washed over him as he realized his efforts were futile.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari befoyda ekanligini anglaganida uni umidsizlik hissi qamrab oldi.
cards.uzDef: Yordam beradigan hech narsa yo'q degan his.

cards.ex: The boxer had his opponent on the ropes in the final round.
cards.exUz: Bokschining raqibi oxirgi raundda yengilish arafasida edi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy muammolarga duch kelish va muvaffaqiyatsizlikka yaqin bo'lish.

cards.ex: Despite the challenges, there's a glimmer of optimism about the future.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, kelajakka nisbatan optimizm uchquni bor.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, lekin sezilarli optimizm hissi.

cards.ex: She resigned herself to the fact that she would never be a professional athlete.
cards.exUz: U hech qachon professional sportchi bo'lmasligiga ko'nikdi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan narsaga ko'nikish.

cards.ex: He struggled against despair by focusing on the small victories.
cards.exUz: U kichik g'alabalarga e'tibor qaratib umidsizlik bilan kurashdi.
cards.uzDef: Umidsizlik hissini yengish uchun harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Her dreams were dashed to pieces when she failed the audition.
cards.exUz: Kastingdan o'ta olmaganida uning orzulari parchalanib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Umidsizlikdan buzilgan, vayron qilingan.

cards.ex: The team is down but not out; they still have a chance to win.
cards.exUz: Jamoa yutqazayotgan bo'lsa ham, mag'lub emas; ularda g'alaba qozonish uchun hali imkoniyat bor.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yomon bo'lsada hali imkoniyat bor.
